verdict.rationale: Reducto's own CLI is documented for batch processing and can parse a whole directory, writing one output per input file. Separately, Parse and Extract jobs can be submitted through a batch queue at a 20% discount, and async run_job returns job IDs for non-blocking submission. Together these cover running operations across many documents at once. missing for 10: detailed batch-queue API docs (submission format, limits, aggregate status/results), directory examples for operations beyond parse, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Use it for batch processing, scripting, CI/CD pipelines
The CLI writes `<filename>.parse.md` next to each input file.
Parse and Extract jobs submitted through the batch queue receive a 20% usage discount.
